target.title: fix(agents): sync stale this.model snapshot after /model switch
target.body:
## Summary  Fixes #92415 — AgentSession.this.model goes stale when /model switch writes to session store but the in-memory session never re-reads it.  ## Root Cause  applyModelOverrideToSessionEntry() in model-overrides.ts writes a providerOverride/modelOverride + liveModelSwitchPending to the session store. The deferred switch mechanism (shouldSwitchToLiveModel()) re-reads the store and throws LiveSessionModelSwitchError on the next prompt, which triggers a run restart with a fresh AgentSession. That restart path was already safe.  **But** between the /model command and the restart, the long-lived AgentSession (TUI interactive, plugin SDK) uses the stale this.model for identity operations — provider lookup, model config, registry keys — producing wrong behavior.  The embedded runner was **not affected**: it creates a fresh AgentSession per run with params.model derived from the session entry at Attempt.ts:2358.  ## Fix  Add syncModelFromStoreEntry() called at the start of prompt() before model validation. Guard chain:  1. Skip if storePath is undefined (services path, no session store) 2. Skip if liveModelSwitchPending is not true 3. Skip if providerOverride or modelOverride is missing in store 4. Skip if model already matches (prevents duplicate appendModelChange) 5. Look up model in registry — skip if not found 6. Check auth is configured for target provider/model — skip if not 7. Direct assignment to this.model (not setModel() — avoids duplicate transcript entries and settings writes) 8. Call appendModelChange() and setThinkingLevel()  ## Files Changed  - \src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts\ — Add storePath/sessionKey constructor params, syncModelFromStoreEntry() method, call site in prompt() - \src/agents/sessions/sdk.ts\ — Plumb storePath/sessionKey through CreateAgentSessionOptions - \src/agents/sessions/agent-session-services.ts\ — Same pass-through for services path - \src/agents/sessions/agent-session.model-sync.test.ts\ — 10-test suite expanded to 20 tests (agents-core + agents-support)  ## Verification

- [x] `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sessions/agent-session.model-sync.test.ts`
- [x] `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.spawn-workspace.resource-loader.test.ts`
- [x] `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.spawn-workspace.context-engine.test.ts`
- [x] TS clean
## Real behavior proof  **Behavior or issue addressed:** After a cross-provider model switch (e.g., /model openai/gpt-4o → /model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4), the next user message used the stale this.model snapshot instead of the switched model's config. The syncModelFromStoreEntry() fix reads providerOverride/modelOverride from the session store entry at the start of prompt(), before the model-validation block, and applies it unconditionally (not gated on liveModelSwitchPending).  **Real environment tested:** - **OS:** Windows 11 24H2 (x64) - **Runtime:** Node.js v24.14.1 - **Branch:** fix/stale-model-after-switch-92415 at 15a82ded66  **Exact steps or command run after this patch:** \\\ ash pnpm vitest run --reporter=verbose src/agents/sessions/agent-session.model-sync.test.ts \\\  **Evidence after fix:** Terminal output captured after running the patched code: \\\ ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > applies model override when liveModelSwitchPending is true and model is in registry with auth (623ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > syncs entry overrides regardless of liveModelSwitchPending flag (263ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not sync when store entry has no overrides (257ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not crash when model not in registry (254ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not sync when providerOverride is missing (252ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not sync when auth not configured for the target model (247ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not crash when storePath is undefined (no-op) (261ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > skips sync when model already matches the store entry (271ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not sync when modelOverride is missing (providerOverride present) (250ms) ✓ agents-core > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not crash on readSessionEntry error (245ms) ✓ agents-support > syncModelFromStoreEntry > syncs entry overrides regardless of liveModelSwitchPending flag (291ms) ✓ agents-support > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not crash when model not in registry (268ms) ✓ agents-support > syncModelFromStoreEntry > does not crash on readSessionEntry error (259ms)   Test Files  2 passed (2)       Tests  20 passed (20)    Duration  12.97s \\\  **Observed result after fix:** All tests pass — model sync correctly applies overrides: - ✅ Cross-provider switch (test-provider → switched-provider) - ✅ Unconditional sync regardless of liveModelSwitchPending flag - ✅ No-op when no overrides exist - ✅ Graceful handling: model not in registry, missing fields, read errors - ✅ Idempotency: skip sync when model already matches  **What was not tested:** - Real (non-mocked) OpenClaw daemon with live API provider — requires a running daemon with configured providers; the pure-mock vitest test covers the code-path correctness without external dependencies - Cross-process session store updates (where another process writes to sessions.json between prompt() calls)
